brief:
An Israeli attack killed a four-year-old Palestinian in Gaza, Middle East Eye reported. The strike occurred during at least two separate Israeli operations targeting civilian areas in central Gaza on Thursday, with one hitting Nuseirat refugee camp and another striking Zawayda nearby. At least two people were killed across the two attacks.

The deaths marked the latest casualties in the ongoing conflict between Israeli forces and Palestinian armed groups in the enclave. Gaza has faced sustained military operations for months, with civilian areas including refugee camps coming under repeated Israeli fire.

title: Israeli strike kills four-year-old Palestinian in central Gaza
